description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2059/68 of 23.02.2018, Kesbewa D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing servitude rights, access rights, life interests, and expunging particulars for various land parcels. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land title modifications, servitude rights, and property boundary adjustments.
